What happens in the chat?

When you send the draft, the school receives your message from your WhatsApp number. Please leave out your child’s name, marks and documents.

The office can confirm fees, availability and a time to visit.

  1. Give permission for a call

    The chat asks a parent or guardian aged 18 or over whether the office may call this number. You can agree or decline.

  2. Check the class

    Check the class shown, or enter one if you started a general enquiry. You can change the class before confirming.

  3. Send the enquiry

    When the details are right, choose “Send enquiry” to request a call from the office.

Plan your school budget

Use the written fee details from the office to estimate your annual and first-year costs. For recurring costs, enter the full-year amount in rupees.

You can leave any amount blank. It counts as zero in your estimate. The calculation stays on this device.

Admission questions

All questions for the school
How do I ask about a class?

Choose a class on the admissions page to open a WhatsApp draft, or call the school office. If you send the message, the chat asks an adult to agree to a call back.

Does an enquiry reserve a seat?

An enquiry starts a conversation. The school office confirms availability, explains the document requirements and tells you how to complete admission.

How do we find out the fees?

Ask the office for a written fee breakdown for your class. Include books, uniform and transport if you need them. The budget planner can add up the amounts the office gives you.

Which documents will I need?

The list depends on the class and previous school. Ask the office for the current checklist and how to present the documents. Keep identity documents out of the initial WhatsApp enquiry.

Have a question about the school?Classes, fees and visits+
Where should we start for a young child?

Start with Nursery or KG. The office can help decide the appropriate class and explain age eligibility.

See the early-years guide
What are the current fees?

Fees depend on the class. Ask the office for tuition and any separate costs for books, uniform or transport. You can request a written fee breakdown.

Contact the office
How do we visit the campus?

Find the school opposite Mela Ground in Amet. Call before travelling so the office can confirm a suitable time.

What can we choose in Class 11?

Science, Commerce and Arts are the school’s streams. Ask the office to confirm individual subjects, eligibility and availability.
